column1: # SHIN MEGAMI TENSEI V: Vengeance 1.0.3, Atlus / Unreal Engine 4.27, SDK 15.3.2, NVN.
# subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie, the same build as Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door.
# nninitStartup (+0x1b88a10) reserves one address region for the engine, 62 GB by default;
# the rewriter's engine-wide gate on the store of its size
# (dm/tools/ue_region.py; hle_svc.c) gives it what the alias region has room for
# FMallocBinned3's 37 GB pool reservation is replaced by the host's malloc zone
# (the rewriter's engine-wide cut, dm/tools/ue_malloc.py; hle_uemalloc.c). The SDK-wide
# rules give its SDK build the 62 MB node area and 2 MB region alignment (sdk_patches.py).
# The Switch profile caps Project.FrameRateLimit at 30 and rhi.syncinterval at 2.
# hle_fpslock.c raises both console variables, found by name by the rewriter
# (ue_cvar.py); Unreal applies the project limit through GameUserSettings to
# t.MaxFPS, so ue_fps_cvar names it instead of t.MaxFPS. DM_FPS_TARGET=30 restores 30.
# Shaders are inline in cooked packages in the six Unreal paks (Oodle / Zlib blocks, inline shader records).
